en.headline: Customs seizes 18kg of suspected scheduled dried shark fins at Lo Wu
en.dek: Officers intercepted a 68-year-old mainland woman arriving on Monday and handed the batch, valued at about HK$45,000, to the AFCD for investigation.
body: Hong Kong Customs seized 18 kilograms of suspected scheduled dried shark fins of endangered species at the Lo Wu Control Point on Monday.
Officers intercepted an incoming 68-year-old mainland female passenger at the Arrival Hall. The batch, with an estimated market value of about HK$45,000, was found in her personal baggage.

Officers of the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department attended and preliminarily identified the fins as of species listed under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species and regulated by local law. The case was handed over to the AFCD for follow-up. Customs reminded the public not to carry controlled items into or out of Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 海關羅湖截查內地婦 檢18公斤懷疑瀕危乾魚翅
zh.dek: 周一在入境大堂截獲一名68歲抵港內地女旅客行李內的乾魚翅，估計市值約4.5萬元，已交漁護署跟進。
body: 香港海關周一在羅湖管制站檢獲18公斤懷疑屬瀕危物種的乾魚翅。
人員在入境大堂截查一名68歲抵港內地女旅客，在其個人行李內發現該批乾魚翅，估計市值約4.5萬元。
漁農自然護理署人員到場查驗，初步鑑定屬《瀕危野生動植物種國際貿易公約》附錄所列物種，受本港條例管制。案件已交漁護署跟進。海關提醒市民切勿攜帶受管制物品進出香港。
